request: We need to implement the retry behaviour that RFC-0001 already approved.
We have settled on PostgreSQL over MySQL for the reporting store after comparing both; the choice is made.
We have decided to replace our earlier choice of Redis for web sessions (ADR-0002) with signed cookies; the decision is settled.
Several teams disagree on how services should version their public APIs, the direction is still open, and every owner has to agree.
This repository has one maintainer. Change the charter's mission to serve a different kind of user.
This repository has one maintainer. Change who is allowed to approve pull requests.
I want to propose that services share one logging library.
Add CSV export to the reports page; the behaviour is agreed and needs acceptance criteria written down.
Rename a private helper in the parser module; no behaviour changes.
Track the work to upgrade our test runner next quarter.
One team owns the orders service and still has to choose its architecture: event sourcing or plain CRUD. No one else is affected.
Try a new linter on one package for two weeks; we drop it if it raises more than five false positives a day.
